description: Send a REVIEW COPY of an email to the rep for approval — NOT to the lead. Renders exactly as the real send (same from-address/signature/placeholders via the lead+campaign) but is delivered to the reviewer and clearly marked as a draft: the subject is prefixed '[DRAFT — review copy]' and a banner naming the real intended recipient is prepended to the body. Recipient defaults to the authenticated caller's own account email; pass to_address to send the review copy somewhere else. Required: lead_id, subject, body. Optional: to_address (review recipient), campaign_id, intended_to (the lead's real address, shown in the banner), bcc. NOTE: the campaign's bcc_emails archive does NOT apply here — a review copy never reached the lead, and filing it would make the archive unreadable; pass bcc explicitly if this copy should go somewhere else too. Returns { ok, draft_id, sent_to }. After approval, call send_email to send the real thing to the lead.

bcc.description: Blind-copy recipients for this review copy — array or comma-separated string. The campaign's archive BCC is deliberately not applied to review copies.

intended_to.description: The lead's real email, shown in the draft banner

to_address.description: Where to send the review copy (default: caller's own email)

name: send_draft_email
